info.title: STN API
info.description: Non-live integration API. Clinician sign-in via OIDC, server-side roles (clinician, reviewer, admin), MFA enforcement and organisation scoping; encrypted, owner-scoped client and assessment records with key rotation; human review and sign-off workflow; consent records, legal holds and two-person disposal; logged exports; reviewer assignment; clinician account registry with two-person reactivation and access review; client access and correction requests; rate limiting (in-process or Redis); hash-chained audit. No diagnosis, scoring, risk disposition or crisis automation is exposed.
